title: How the research tool works
subtitle: A transcript goes in one end and a placed, reviewed record comes out the other. Every machine step has a human step after it, and every import can be rolled back to the checkpoint it started from.

steps.label: Source of record
steps.note: Every record keeps a link back to the transcript line it came from

steps.label: /synthesise
steps.note: Reads the transcript and emits candidate insights as JSON

steps.label: Schema validation
steps.note: Type, stakeholder, stage, substage and theme must all resolve or the batch is refused

steps.label: Git checkpoint
steps.note: Tag pre-import-{batch}, so a bad batch is one command to undo

steps.label: Review, record by record
steps.note: Read against the transcript, corrected where the extraction flattened what someone meant

steps.label: Typed record
steps.note: Pain point, action, decision, behaviour, process gap or opportunity

steps.label: Placed on the blueprint
steps.note: Tied to one of 5 stages, 11 substages and the role it concerns

steps.label: 184 blueprint items
steps.note: The service as a role by stage grid, in SQLite

steps.label: Evidence trail
steps.note: Finding, to substage, to decision, to proposal

steps.label: Findings report
steps.note: Generated from the records rather than retyped from a board

steps.label: Miro board
steps.note: Frames per stage, colour coded stickies per role, pushed by the migrator

steps.label: Drafted recommendations
steps.note: Anthropic SDK, five templates; the prompt is stored with its output

steps.label: Edited before use
steps.note: Nothing reaches the report or a stakeholder unedited

footer: Python, Flask and SQLite with a vanilla JavaScript front end; 50 HTTP routes and 2,674 lines in the server; 318 commits between 27 October 2025 and 22 January 2026. Counts are from the tool's own database and the December 2025 findings report.
